question.prompt: In square \(ABCD\), rotate \(\triangle ADF\) through \(90^\circ\) about point \(A\) so that \(AD\) coincides with \(AB\). The point corresponding to \(F\) is \(F'\). If \(DF=3\), find the length of \(BF'\).

solutions.explanation: Corresponding segments before and after a rotation have equal lengths, so \(BF'=DF=3\).
solutions.title: Use corresponding segment lengths
